propositions: Four MCP output models (CreateResultOut, GateResultOut, NextBatchOut, TicketStateOut) under-declare 41 canonical schema properties across their schema.json definitions
Declaring optional pydantic fields causes them to emit, but 15 properties have non-nullable types that violated their own schema when naively declared, caught by contract tests
All 39 newly declared properties were already on the wire as undeclared extra='allow' pass-throughs, so the change documents existing shape rather than altering the wire contract
Two properties (CreateResultOut.title and NextBatchOut.tasks) are deliberately omitted with stated reasons because they belong to CLI-only code paths never traversed by MCP
The _OmitUnsetOut base class with model_serializer suppresses emission of unset fields while preserving them in outputSchema, keeping emitted bytes unchanged
